operation_type.description: Provide the operation type. Allowed values: Create, Modify. Synonyms must be normalized to the canonical value.
operation_type.x-a2at-value-constraint: Allowed canonical values: Create, Modify. Normalize synonyms to the canonical value instead of treating them as out-of-range: Add / Implement / Establish / Deploy / Set Up / Provision / New / Enable / Activate / Configure are all Create; Update / Adjust / Change / Revise / Edit are all Modify.

task_description.description: Dynamically provide the task description based on the operation type (Create/Modify).
examples: Based on [Task Object](#task-object) and [Task Context](#task-context), output a wireless network energy saving plan that achieves the wireless network energy saving goal defined in [Task Target](#task-target), and return the wireless network energy saving result in the format defined in [Expected Output](#expected-output).
task_description.x-a2at-value-constraint: When the type is [Create]: Based on [Task Object](#task-object) and [Task Context](#task-context), output a wireless network energy saving plan that achieves the wireless network energy saving goal defined in [Task Target](#task-target), and return the wireless network energy saving result in the format defined in [Expected Output](#expected-output). When the type is [Modify]: Based on [Task Object](#task-object) and [Task Context](#task-context), output a wireless network energy saving plan that achieves the wireless network energy saving goal defined in [Task Target](#task-target). The value must always be non-null. The [Task Object](#task-object) and [Task Context](#task-context) placeholders must be formatted from the values of the task_object and task_context slots respectively.

task_object.description: Explicitly specify the energy saving coverage scope information, a geographic or logical area (e.g., district-level administrative unit). The area information is a required parameter.
examples: The area is the Songshanhu Administration Committee.
task_object.x-a2at-value-constraint: Area name. A named region (a specific region name such as "A2ATestRegion" or "Slice A") is valid. Only anonymous vague descriptions that carry no concrete region name, such as "test area", "sites in this area", "all communities", "indoor communities", or "outdoor communities", must report slot.not_provided with slot_label 'Area' and actual describing what is missing. Only one region name is allowed; if the input specifies multiple regions, report slot.constraint_violated.

task_target.description: Define the quantitative or qualitative goals the task must achieve. Quantitative and qualitative goals cannot be selected at the same time, and the default is a qualitative goal.
task_target.x-a2at-value-constraint: 1. Quantitative goal: energy saving gain target as a single percentage (e.g. 30%). A range (e.g. '20%-30%') reports slot.constraint_violated. 2. Qualitative goal: maximize energy saving under the task context conditions. The mode must be one of Aggressive, Conservative, Lossless Experience, Lossy Experience (synonyms are listed in the [terminology] section below); other values (e.g. 'green') report slot.constraint_violated. A numeric throughput/rate/UX target is a rate guarantee goal, not a mode, and must not be treated as a mode violation.

task_context.description: Provide the background and context information for task execution.
examples: Cell RAT for energy saving: NR; Energy saving time range: start time "08:00:00", end time "12:00:00"; Time-segmented rate guarantee goal: {00:00~06:00,2Mbps}, {06:00~18:00,10Mbps}.
task_context.x-a2at-value-constraint: 1. Cell RAT: LTE, NR, LNR, all (synonyms are listed in the [terminology] section below). Invalid values (e.g. '3G') report slot.constraint_violated. 2. Cross-task reference: if the input inherits parameters by referencing an earlier task (e.g. 'same as the previous task') but multiple earlier tasks exist and the reference is ambiguous, report slot.constraint_violated with slot_label 'Task reference'. Do not silently pick one candidate; set value to null. 3. Energy saving time range, recurring daily; if omitted, full-period energy saving. Rate goal is guaranteed only within this range. 4. Carrier frequencies that can be turned off. When carrier turn-off is requested but concrete frequency points are missing, report slot.not_provided with slot_label 'Carrier frequencies'. A frequency must be a specific number (e.g. 1600), not an approximation (e.g. 'approximately 1600'); approximations report slot.constraint_violated. 5. Rate guarantee goal: minimum downlink throughput target and its effective time period. Area-level supports time-segmented/full-period; site-level requires site list, time-segmented rate goal, and optional background event and duration. Time windows MUST NOT overlap and must fall within the energy-saving execution period; overlapping windows report slot.constraint_violated with slot_label 'Time windows'. Vague time descriptions (busy/idle/peak/off-peak) report slot.constraint_violated. A vague rate (e.g. 'maximize the rate' without a number) reports slot.not_provided with slot_label 'Guaranteed rate'. When a rate change is tied to a concrete time range but no rate value is given, report slot.not_provided with slot_label 'Guaranteed rate'; a general 'modify the throughput target' without a concrete time range is acceptable. 6. In outage/modify scenarios, the affected site list (concrete site names, not 'sites in this area' or '10 sites') and outage start/end time (concrete times, not 'tomorrow' or 'five-hour') are REQUIRED. Missing outage time reports slot.not_provided with slot_label 'Outage start/end time'; missing sites reports slot.not_provided with slot_label 'Site list'. Outage duration must be a single specific number (e.g. 3 hours), not a range (e.g. '2 or 3 hours'); ranges report slot.constraint_violated.

expected_output.description: When the task object is a geographic/logical area, output the intent report for the network energy saving task.
expected_output.x-a2at-value-constraint: Basic information about the intent execution result: area, intent goal achievement status. Detailed information about the intent execution result: energy saving gain achievement status (current energy saving gain goal, actual energy saving gain percentage, target adjustment suggestions), rate goal achievement status (current rate goal, actual rate, target adjustment suggestions).
